name: Love Mission
source:
Kairi, a second-class spy from a spy academy, gets orders to steal data from one of the top academies of an enemy country. He is surprised that they would trust him with a X-level mission, but still disguises himself as a new student and enters the academy. The environment in the academy and the people are completely different from his reports. He spends his time with an old childhood friend and some very cool, new friends. At the same time, he has to remind himself that he has a mission to fulfill.....

[From Aarinfantasy Forums]
